title: How to Build an Airbnb and Short-Stay Management System from Scratch
summary: Learn how to build an Airbnb and short-stay management system from scratch, covering finance, maintenance, and checklists.
body_markdown:
To **build an Airbnb and short-stay management system** from scratch, start with a central property record, then expand into finance, maintenance, cleaning checklists, and owner communication, all connected to that same record. In **Jestor** , this structure comes together without code, using relational tables.


Operators starting out with just a few properties often manage everything in a spreadsheet, and that works for a while. The problem shows up when the number of units grows faster than the spreadsheet can keep up.


Building the right system from the start avoids having to rebuild everything later, once the operation is bigger and harder to reorganize.


## What to Structure First


1. A central property table, with address, owner, and contact details
2. A maintenance request form, linked to each property
3. A standard check-in and check-out checklist, with defined tasks and owners
4. A finance table linked to the ERP, for payables and receivables by property
5. A centralized communication channel with owners and field teams


## How to Connect Each Part


- The property record becomes the base: everything (maintenance, finance, checklist) connects to it
- Maintenance requests follow an approval limit before becoming a posted expense
- The cleaning checklist generates automatic tasks with each new reservation or guest checkout
- Finance syncs with the ERP, avoiding manual entry of each approved expense


System component Function


Property record Central base connecting everything else


Maintenance with approval limits Approval before becoming an expense


Cleaning checklist Quality standard across properties


ERP-integrated finance Payables and receivables with no manual entry


## Why Build This System in **Jestor**


- Relational tables connect properties, maintenance, finance, and checklists in one place
- Native automations create cleaning tasks automatically with every new reservation cycle
- Native integration with **Omie** and **Conta Azul** for property-level finance
- The **AI App Builder** helps set up this initial structure from a text description

## Frequently asked questions


**Do I need to know how to code to build this system?** No, **Jestor** tables, forms, and automations are all configured without code.


**Can I start with a few properties and grow later?** Yes, the structure works for both small and large property portfolios; see more at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Does this system replace the reservation channel manager?** No, it covers the internal operations side; reservation syncing stays with the chosen channel manager.


**Is there a ready-made template to start faster?** Yes, you can start from an existing template and adapt it to your operation's specific fields.


Following these steps to **build an Airbnb and short-stay management system** from scratch avoids having to rebuild everything once the operation is already bigger.
